articles.headline: 'Every team does it': How World Cup sides thwart opponents' spy efforts
articles.description: Soccer is full of people who are either (A) spying on someone; (B) actively worried that someone is spying on them; or (C) both. So how do they stop it?

articles.headline: How Alex Freeman's Pro Bowl dad helped him live his World Cup dream
articles.description: Antonio Freeman taught son Alex what it takes to be a pro. It was his mom and his stepdad, though, who taught the USMNT defender to love soccer.

articles.headline: Messi, Haaland, Mbappé, Kane: Who will be the World Cup's top scorer?
articles.description: We're more than a week into the 2026 World Cup, and the race for the Golden Boot -- given to the tournament's top goal scorer -- is heating up.

articles.headline: Japan rout Tunisia 4-0, eliminate Hervé Renard from the World Cup
articles.description: A dominant Japan produced the biggest margin of victory for an Asian nation in a World Cup match as they beat Tunisia 4-0

articles.headline: FIFA World Cup 2026 stats: Room's all-time record 15; Undav equals Milla 5; Japan's 4 creates history
articles.description: ESPN's By The Numbers brings you best stats from the World Cup action on June 20.

articles.headline: How European teams are trying to beat the World Cup heat
articles.description: European teams don't do well in the heat of North America, with just two World Cup wins outside Europe since 1930. Will the heat decide who wins in 2026? And what are teams doing to combat that?
